questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman presents to her primary care physician with concerns about her behavior. She reports that she has been experiencing irresistible urges to set fires, which she has acted upon several times in the past few months. She feels relief after setting the fires but later feels guilty and ashamed. She has not experienced any legal consequences yet but is worried about her safety and the safety of others. Based on her symptoms, what is the most likely diagnosis?
